title.zh: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
title.en: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO

current_state.zh: Nvidia-backed AI computing startup Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation, led by Coatue and Blackstone, ahead of a planned 2027 IPO.
